headline: President Bush changes five earlier executive orders and cancels a sixth, Executive Order 13011.
what_it_does: This order amends five earlier executive orders: 11030, 13279, 13339, 13381, and 13389. It also fully cancels Executive Order 13011. Only the title is available, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies that carry out the amended or canceled orders may have to follow updated instructions.

when_it_takes_effect: Not stated in the source; it was signed May 12, 2006.
